But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 1986

themoviechannel.us.title: Wild Wild West
themoviechannel.us.description: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Relic
themoviechannel.us.description: A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home. (Horror) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy II
themoviechannel.us.description: Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) rises from hell to declare war on God and humanity. To win the spiritual war, Gabriel has to kill Los Angeles nurse Valerie Rosales (Jennifer Beals) -- and, more importantly, her unborn half-angel baby. Helping Gabriel track Rosales down is a suicidal teenager (Brittany Murphy). Meanwhile, good angel Danyael (Russell Wong) marshals all his heavenly powers to protect Rosales and her child from Gabriel's clutches. (Horror) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
themoviechannel.us.description: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. (Science fiction, Dark comedy) - 1982

themoviechannel.us.title: Million Dollar Baby
themoviechannel.us.description: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. (Drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Not Without Hope
themoviechannel.us.description: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Carriers
themoviechannel.us.description: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
themoviechannel.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. (Animated, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
themoviechannel.us.description: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: Peep World
themoviechannel.us.description: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday. (Comedy) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: She's All That
themoviechannel.us.description: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: He's Just Not That Into You
themoviechannel.us.description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. (Romantic comedy) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: She's the Man
themoviechannel.us.description: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

themoviechannel.us.title: Doin' It
themoviechannel.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. (Comedy) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Super
themoviechannel.us.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. (Action, Comedy) - 2010

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whipsaw
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Hot jewels from London make their way to New York, where they are stolen by racketeer Ed Dexter (Harvey Stephens), who hides them with the help of his vivacious girlfriend, Vivian Palmer (Myrna Loy). Federal agent Ross McBride (Spencer Tracy) goes undercover to infiltrate Dexter's gang and, suspecting Vivian can lead him to the jewels, comes to her aid when she is chased by a rival gang. The two flee to the Midwest with both gangs in pursuit -- but Vivian is not as gullible as Ross thinks. (Crime drama) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Wife vs. Secretary
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Though magazine publisher Van Stanhope (Clark Gable) and his wife, Linda (Myrna Loy), are contentedly married, Van's meddling mother (May Robson) doesn't trust his attractive young secretary, Helen "Whitey" Wilson (Jean Harlow). When Whitey helps Van undertake a top-secret plan to purchase a potentially profitable magazine from under the nose of a rival publisher, causing the pair to work long hours alone together, Linda's sudden jealousy almost scuttles both the deal and their marriage. (Comedy drama) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Petticoat Fever
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A lonesome wireless operator (Robert Montgomery) delays a couple (Myrna Loy, Reginald Owen) stranded in Labrador. (Comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Parnell
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1880, Irish politician Charles Stewart Parnell (Clark Gable) returns home from a successful trip to America. Although jailed briefly for sedition, Parnell is cleared and stands in the House of Commons. He then supports the aspirations of Capt. William O'Shea (Alan Marshal), who although estranged from his wealthy wife, Katherine (Myrna Loy), asks her to assist him in befriending Parnell. When the militant-minded opposition tries to discredit Parnell, Katie stands by the politician. (Biography) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Man-Proof
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Mimi Swift (Myrna Loy) has been chasing self-absorbed ladies' man Alan Wythe (Walter Pidgeon) for years, but he's looking for a woman with a bigger pocketbook than Mimi can provide. She's crushed when Alan finally announces he's getting hitched, and matters are made worse when it turns out he's taking Mimi's rich pal, Elizabeth (Rosalind Russell), as his bride. But after suffering through the indignity of being a bridesmaid at the couple's wedding, Mimi decides she can't give up on Alan yet. (Comedy drama) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Test Pilot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Test pilot Jim Lane (Clark Gable) has endangered himself more than once because of his drinking. Despite efforts by his best friend, Gunner (Spencer Tracy), Jim has not quit the bottle. After making an emergency landing on a Kansas farm, Jim falls for, then marries, local girl Ann (Myrna Loy), but married life cannot keep Jim from indulging in his reckless ways. Then, on a dangerous mission with Gunner, Jim finally confronts something that just may scare him into never flying again. (Adventure) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Too Hot to Handle
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Chris Hunter (Clark Gable) is a newsreel journalist who never lets the facts get in the way of a good story. When he meets daredevil pilot Alma Harding (Myrna Loy), he puts his charms on her, but she's more interested in going to the Amazon to search for her lost brother than entertaining his advances. In pursuit of her, as well as a hot story, Chris tags along. On the way, he competes with Bill Dennis (Walter Pidgeon), a rival reporter who is also eyeing Alma and the big scoop. (Comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lucky Night
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The beautiful Cora Jordan (Myrna Loy) will one day inherit her father Calvin's (Henry O'Neill) steel fortune. One day, Cora sets out into the world, intent on finding a man and a job of her own. However, Cora is unable to find work and quickly realizes the real world isn't as welcoming as she had imagined. But she is cheered up by Bill Overton (Robert Taylor), a charming homeless man. The two share a wild, drunken night that ends in a way neither of them could have imagined. (Comedy) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cheaper by the Dozen
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Based on the true story of the large Gilbreth family, this film follows Frank Gilbreth and his wife, Lillian, as they raise their 12 children. Both renowned efficiency experts, Frank and Lillian face significant challenges in parenting such a big brood, often leading to humorous situations. Fortunately, the couple frequently receives assistance from their eldest daughter, Ann, who often acts as a third parent to the many Gilbreth children. (Children, Comedy drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: From the Terrace
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Alfred Eaton (Paul Newman) returns home after World War II, driven to be as successful as possible out of hatred toward his wealthy father (Leon Ames). He is unendingly ambitious: founding an aircraft construction company with his friend Lex (George Grizzard), marrying a socialite (Joanne Woodward) and leveraging a fortunate encounter with a powerful financier (Felix Aylmer) into a new career. When he meets the beautiful, truthful Natalie (Ina Balin), Alfred has a crisis of conscience. (Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Midnight Lace
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When the American wife of a wealthy London-based financier starts receiving frightening phone calls, she believes her life is in danger, but when she protests to her family following a near-fatal accident, they and the police doubt her claims and even her sanity. (Mystery) - 1960

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Power Play Professor Kranium hijacks the launch of the Peak City Heroes' action figures by hacking into the toys.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E9 Levi Learns Take home readers - best day ever for Little J, and worst day ever for Levi!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Football Fantastics ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 The Sack The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team's new coach, but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs with chaotic results.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Guardian of the Tooth When Flower loses her first tooth, she enlists Flour the cat to help keep it safe and make sure the tooth fairy can find it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E17 Ocean Gardens Tammy meets the kids at the beach to explore rock pools and see the plants and animals that live in them. The team use jars to collect water and bits of seaweed from the ocean and observe the plankton and microorganisms.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E24 Police Boat Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are out with Grandpa on his boat. They are playing pirates. Police Officers Panda and Police Officer Squirrel are in their Police Boat. The children get to go on the police boat.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E25 The Tractor Peppa and some of her friends visit Mrs. Badger's Farm. Mrs. Badger shows them how the tractor works, and the tractor's trailer is used to drive the children around the farm. Mummy and Daddy Pig's car gets stuck in a muddy field.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: It's Andrew!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 Big BIG Looksalotl When the kindy school's pet escapes from its hutch in the classroom, the Looksalotl, a shy shape-shifting creature, hides so well it might never be found. It's up to Andrew to find a gentle way to coax it back out of hiding.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Highway Rat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Iron Hulk and the Bees/ Fly Away Iron Friends Amadeus shows off his high-tech bee hive, but when Swarm attacks, the Iron Friends must save the day and the bees. The Iron Friends stop Ultron from making everyone float away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E11 Take Away The tempting aroma of the Farmer's takeaway inspires Shaun and his pals to go on a mission to the local pizzeria, disguised as a human.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E38 Cubby Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Pay Attention Pearl Pearl is sure Mara has Flailing Tail but when purple spots appear on other patients, Zog and Gadabout suspect there's something afoot. Will Pearl listen to them?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E21 The Mystery Badge When King Tiger suddenly cries out that his ruby has gone, the missing jewel turns the party into a mystery to be solved. Luckily Duggee has his Mystery Badge and some enthusiastic Squirrels to investigate!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Rocket Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Interstellar Treasure Hunt TAC discovers an Interstellar Treasure Map that leads Rocket Club on a mysterious and fun-filled scavenger hunt throughout the Galaxy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Getting Older Wizz is growing old, fast. Way too fast! If you keep watching, he'll be 100 years old before the end of the episode!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E39 The Sleepover A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 The Ya Ya The children discuss that Atticus has been acting strangely all week and that it might have something to do with his parents going away. Atticus confesses that he is upset because he is starving.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Everyone Lies Gabriel and Penelope face-off in Full Disclosure and go to extreme lengths to dig for dirt. Ade and Ede learn that it's risky to trust a crook.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark? ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Destroy All Tophats With her friends' lives at stake, Rachel decides to take charge and end Mr. Tophat's reign of terror. Will this story have a happy ending. or is the Midnight Society doomed?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ice Age
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 A Frozen World The woolly mammoth and sabre tooth cat are brought back to life as we learn how these mighty beasts survived such savage environmental extremes and reveal why they could not survive when the ice began to thaw.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Pressure Drop The MythBusters build a pressure cannon to see if a ping pong ball impact could be fatal. They also test the affect of water pressure on a deep sea diver, and find out if firehose pressure is enough to lift a car.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Cannons This time The Slow Mo Guys go Medieval and look at the amazing world of Cannons. How far can Cannons fire?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E2 Episode 2 The huge axe of Robot Thor driven by Jason, a builder from Northampton, clashes with Will and Ian from Team Shockwave. Judge Sethu Vijayakumar discusses his work with NASA in creating androids for the Mission to Mars.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E15 A Lobster, an Armadillo and a Way Bigger Number Sheldon joins Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis on a science road trip, which lands them in the middle of nowhere. Meanwhile, Georgie continues to lie about his age.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E58 Portrait Artist We meet Australia's Portrait Artist of the Year, 18-year-old Jasmine Lancaster-Merton. We find out what it was like winning the competition and how she juggles Year 12 with her passion for portraits.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E10 Pros and Con Artists As May prepares for her second contest, Ash faces her rival Drew in a pre-contest battle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E21 The Start of Vengeance! The Frieza Force's Malice Strikes Gohan! Without any way to get a hold of Goku or Vegeta, only Gohan and the remaining Z fighters are ready to face Frieza. Up against 1000 troops and the emperor of evil, our heroes may face more of a challenge than expected!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E24 Icy Nights II Ice Bear goes on a late-night adventure to rescue his friend, Yana.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E15 Kwamibuster Ms Mendeleiev gets akumatized into Kwamibuster, she wants to capture Tikki and Plagg to prove to the world that these magical creatures are real. Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to protect their secret at all costs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E8 Friendship; Vegetables The Titans discover they're trapped in an episode of Raven's favourite show. // The group tries living as vegetarians and realises it's a lifestyle that's not for everyone.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E36 Baby Mouth In order to find out about his family history, Robin takes a DNA test and discovers he's from Babylon.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Camping Is In Tents - Part 2 A class camping trip turns into a treasure hunt while Harold is determined to catch Bigfoot and keep everyone safe.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 An Egg-stremely Bad Idea Hoping to 'brighten her day', Izzy and Owen pimp out Gwen's egg chair. But when it ends up in a museum run by angry chickens, they must retrieve it before Gwen destroys the daycare in a temper tantrum of unspeakable darkness.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E40 Ticking Crime Bomb Leshawna and Izzy trick Owen into thinking he's destined to be a criminal mastermind, but when he leaves school to join the scariest gang in town, they have to mount a rescue attempt.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Cheep Thrills Bubbles adopts a baby monster in the park.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E26 Bucketboy! When the girls tell Barry he's a hero, he takes it too far.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Operation Ouch!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E8 How Your Reflexes Can Save You Dr Xand invents a crazy game show to put Dr Chris' reactions and reflexes to the test in the lab, and Dr Ronx heads out on call with the emergency services.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E7 The Play When Miss Grayling invites a potential investor to the school, the girls must put on a day to impress. It's the day of Georgina's beloved play and Darrell is tasked to lead a tour - but all doesn't quite go to plan!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 The Case Of The Burgled Bags When Gary, the school's lollipop man, is accused of stealing bags from parents' cars, Kyle is devastated and determined to clear his name.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teletubbies
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Tallest Shortest The Teletubbies are standing up straight to see who is the tallest and who is the shortest. Tinky Winky and Po play 'Tallest, Shortest' with the Tiddlytubbies and the children in Tummy Tales put themselves in height order.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E79 Jewels the Winner / Abuelita's Shawl Jewels wants to win. Lucia gifts a new shawl.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E34 Juan Carlos Visits the Neighbourhood; Daniel Shows Juan Carlos the Clock Daniel can't wait to show Juan Carlos the Clock Factory, but remembers to ask Juan Carlos what he wants to do first. Daniel is a good host and they make a stop at the Music Shop for Juan Carlos and his mom.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Maddie & Triggs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 Ice Cream While visiting Mr. Moon's shop with Granny, Maddie finds it difficult to choose what type of ice cream to get - there are just so many different flavours to choose from!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E13 The Shooting Star The Wise Old Elf fears an alien invasion after a presumed shooting star lands in the Little Kingdom.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 A Pirate's Pet The Jedi must free a wild creature captured by Taborr.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E19 The Power of Mystery Mountain / The Power of Mystery Mountain Part II Mystery Mountain breaks out of its dimension and floats over the city, the heroes band together to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E16 European Bison Periwinkle wanders off during a mission in the Bialowieza Forest in Poland and discovers a rare European Bison stranded and hurt. They scramble to return the bison to the safety of its herd before a hungry bear locates him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S25 E34 The Paint Problem Thomas needs repainting and must be patient as he dries, even though he feels like he's missing out.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E2 Leap Blob The Numberblocks have to do some clever counting to cross a sticky swamp.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 Finding Friends Pants and Mittens can't find each other, but no matter where they look. They soon realize they have to think like the other to find one another.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E18 Doing A Handstand Get ready for a Wiggly circus! Join in the fun with the 'Doing a Handstand' sing-along, and you can dance too! We're delighted to welcome Atsuko Arai, singing the beautiful song 'Haru Ga Kita.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E16 The Pelican An unusual guest lands on the Farm. When Shaun and Bitzer realise it's hungry, they set about trying to find it some food - if only they could get their hands on the Farmer's prize catch!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Adventures of Paddington
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E33 Paddington and the Unlikely Hero Who's the mystery hero doing good deeds in Windsor Gardens, and why do they want to remain anonymous? Will Paddington crack the case?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 The Iron Friends vs. The Iron Fiends / Vision's Invisible Trouble Vision's art tour turns dangerous as Ultron threatens to make the museum vanish.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Knee High Spies
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Mission Disco Party Pooper When Silver Paw plots to drop a mirrorball onto a speaker and ruin the kids' disco party, Deena must learn how to dance to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 Aunt May's Mess When Aunt May unknowingly picks up Doc Ock's floating gizmo at the antique store, Spidey and the team must retrieve it before Doc Ock does!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Vida the Vet
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Otto's Crampy Conundrum Otto keeps getting a cramp while teaching dance class, so Vida teaches him to stretch!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Stakeout Strange happenings in the kitchen inspire Flower and Flour to sneak downstairs for a late-night stakeout, only to stumble upon a secret that could lead to the best birthday surprise ever!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E11 Caring For Grandpa Pig Peppa, Suzy, and Granny Pig are visiting Grandpa Pig in the hospital today. After the Doctor's assessment, it is decided that he is now well enough to go home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Hotel Bluey and Bingo run a crazy \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Roller Coaster Brocs The baby Pea-Rexes love to slide down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus, except for Split who is terrified and has to learn to overcome his fears.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E6 Charlene's Dream Gemma talks Big Trev into letting the cadets stay overnight in the submarine for the annual coral spawning, but their dreamy adventure gets derailed when they nearly crash into a sleep-swimming Charlene!

wztv.us.description: Ground and air ambulance bills are higher than ever! Medicare & private insurance may not always cover costs. Imagine getting a bill for thousands of dollars! Protect yourself and let MASA pay ambulance bills your insurance may not.

wztv.us.title: RaceWeek
wztv.us.description: The latest NASCAR news and behind the scenes coverage with a "garage pass" to hear from the drivers, crew chiefs and owners.

wztv.us.title: Perspectives with Alana McLaughlin
wztv.us.description: Ms. Alana McLaughlin, Nashville native, hosts. Featuring local power brokers, mentors and movers-and-shakers, discussing a wide array of topics that are of concern to Nashville, all Tennesseans, and those who just want to hear unique perspectives.

wztv.us.title: Voice of Evangelism
wztv.us.description: David Lankford shares the Gospel and inspires faith.

wztv.us.title: Full Measure With Sharyl Attkisson
wztv.us.description: The investigative journalist pursues untouchable subjects through fearless reporting.

wztv.us.title: FOX News Sunday ᴺᵉʷ
wztv.us.description: Anchor Shannon Bream interviews the biggest newsmakers of the week and leads guests in providing context and analysis of the issues facing Americans.

wztv.us.title: FOX NFL Sunday ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

wztv.us.description: The Falcons host the 49ers at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in an NFL regular-season matchup. The 49ers rely on quarterback Brock Purdy, while the Falcons counter with quarterback Michael Penix Jr. Cornerback A.J. Terrell Jr. is out due to a groin injury.
